card.text: LHS 475 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "LHS 475 b"
sources.quote: LHS 475 b is a terrestrial exoplanet orbiting the star LHS 475 which is about 40.7 light years away, in the constellation of Octans.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around LHS 475. Its orbit and size follow Lustig-Yaeger et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: It was the first extrasolar planet to be confirmed by the James Webb Space Telescope.
